newsitem.title: USA: Chemed Q4 shr rises to $1.01.
newsitem.headline: Chemed Q4 shr rises to $1.01.

text.p: NOTES: Full company name is Chemed Corp.
(a) Amounts for the three months ended December 31, 1996, include pretax capital gains amounting to $10,735,000 ($6,812,000 aftertax or $.69 per share) from the sales of investments.
(b) Amounts for the year ended December 31, 1996, include pretax capital gains amounting to $28,166,000 ($17,731,000 aftertax or $1.81 per share) from the sales of investments.

(c) Amounts for the year ended December 31, 1995, include pretax capital gains amounting to $9,078,000 ($5,882,000 aftertax or $.59 per share) from the sales of investments. In addition, amounts include nonrecurring expenses of $538,000 pretax ($355,000 aftertax; $208,000 or $.02 per share after minority interest) for costs incurred by Roto-Rooter in the third quarter of 1995 as a result of discussions related to Chemed's proposal to acquire the 42 per cent minority interest in Roto-Rooter common stock. These discussions were terminated in August 1995.
(d) Amounts represent adjustments to the accruals relating to operations discontinued in 1991.
